About XRP

XRP is the native asset of the XRP Ledger, an open-source blockchain built for fast, low-cost payments and asset transfers. Ripple uses XRP in some of its cross-border payment products.

Where this XRP price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (XRP-USD), Binance (XRP/USDT) and Kraken (XRP/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 59.78B XRP (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
